senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. preced.; cmp. עָרָה) stripped, naked, bare.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:4">Dem. I, 4</cite> <he>מפרישין אותו ע׳ ובין וכ׳</he> Y. ed. a. Ms. M. (ed. <he>בין</he>, incorr.) you may separate the priest’s gift there from without being dressed (because it requires no benediction), and at twilight (on the eve of the Sabbath); <cite ref="Shabbat 23a:8">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 14a:8">Ib. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>האוחז ס״ת ע׳ נקבר ע׳</he> he who handles a naked scroll of the Law (touches it directly with his bare hand), will he buried naked, expl. <he>ע׳ בלא אותה מצוה</he> bare of the merit of that act (of studying or of rolling and dressing it).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 6:7">Tosef. Keth. VI, 7</cite> <he>פסק … שיעמד ע׳ וילבישנה</he> (not <he>וילבשנו</he>) if he agreed with his son-in-law that he will go naked (deprive himself, if necessary) and dress her, <he>אין אומ׳ יעמד ע׳ וילבישנה וכ׳</he> (not <he>וילבישנו</he>) we do not say, let him become destitute, and he must dress her (make the outfit for her), but he (her father) must cover her as is proper for her; Y. ib. VI, 30ᵈ.

<cite ref="Sotah 21b:6">Sot. 21ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>ערמה</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 8:12">Prov. VIII, 12</cite>) <he>אין … אלא במי שמעמיד עצמו ע׳ עליהן</he> the words of the Law remain only with him who makes himself destitute for their sake (who sacrifices comforts for them); (Var. quot. in Rashi: <he>שמשים עצמו עָרוּם עליה</he> who makes himself cunning about it, i.e. goes to work deliberately, studies systematically); a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרוּמִּים</he>, <he>עֲרוּמִּין</he>.

Snh. 90ᵇ כשהן עומדין עומדין ע׳ וכ׳ when they (the dead) rise, will they rise naked or dressed? Yeb. 63ᵇ אנשי … שמהלכין ע׳ בשוק those of Barbaria … who walk naked in the street; Sifré Deut. 320; a. fr.—Fem. עֲרוּמָּה.

<cite ref="Ketubot 111b">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite>; Snh. l. c. <he>ומה חיטה שנקברה ע׳ וכ׳</he> if the wheat-grain, which is buried naked, comes forth wrapped in many dresses, how much more will the righteous dead rise &c. Ib. VI, 3 <he>אין האשה נסקלת ע׳</he> a woman convict must not be stoned (executed) undressed.
<cite ref="Megillah 12b:3">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד שתהא ע׳</he> provided she (Vashti) will appear undressed.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 75a:2">Snh. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>ימות ולא תעמוד לפניו ע׳</he> let him (the love-sick man) die, but she must not stand undressed before him.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 6:5">Keth. VI, 5</cite> <he>פסק להכניסה ע׳</he> if the father made an agreement that he (the bridegroom) will take her to his house without the customary outfit; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרוּמּוֹת</he>. Meg. l. c. <he>מפשיטתן ע׳</he> (not <he>מפשיטן</he>) she forced them to appear undressed; a. e.
